data.text: 👀 The 🇨🇳 swarm situation at Scarborough Shoal continues. I'm beginning to understand the current Chinese shift in strategy that has apparently increased tensions is likely part of their reply to the Philippines over the collision last month that damaged two Chinese vessels. In particular, announcing a live fire exercise in the WPS, not far from the Philippines is a clear provocation. Not sure how the Philippines intends to answer tactically and operationally just yet, but I would suspect them to maintain their moderate and deliberate approach to managing escalation as they have so far

Maaaring potensyal na mapahusay ng NANDO ang Southwest Monsoon habang papalapit ito sa landmass. Itataas ang Wind Signal No. 1 sa Northern Luzon noong Sabado (20 September), at ang pinakamataas na Wind Signal na maaaring itaas sa buong pagdaan nito ay Wind Signal No. 5 kung isasaalang-alang na ang tropical cyclone na ito ay maaaring umabot sa kategoryang super typhoon.
